<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Watch the project's long processes: one line when one starts, stalls, dies or ends.

```text
Reads, on a loop, the project's long processes — test suites, mutation runs, builds, the
commit hook, whatever the agent launched — from the operating system and from the records
their launchers write in .anchors/runs/, and prints one line for each event that calls for a
reaction:

  ▶ started    ⏸ stalled (no output nor CPU for the runner's threshold)    ▶ moving again
  ☠ died (gone without an exit or a summary)    ✓/✗ ended, with its exit or its summary
  ✓/✗ a test report landed, with its failures    … progress, sparse
  and a heartbeat with what runs — "running=[NOTHING]" included — and the load.

Run it inside your watch tool, after launching the long command in the background, and react
to each line. Its state stays in .anchors/runs/: re-armed, it says what happened while nobody
watched, and nothing twice.

Timing comes from the defaults, then the "monitor:" block of anchors.yaml, then the flags.
```

## Usage

```bash
anchors monitor [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--every` |  | how often to read the processes (default 30s, or monitor.every) |
| `--heartbeat` |  | how often to say what runs, even when nothing changed (default 5m) |
| `--once` |  | read once, print what changed, and exit |
| `--progress` |  | least time between two progress lines of one run (default 5m) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--stall` |  | quiet time before a run of no declared runner is stalled (default 5m) |
| `--until-done` |  | exit when the runs it watches have all ended |

## Subcommands

### `anchors monitor run`

Run a command and record its run for the monitor: process, output and exit.

```text
Runs the command, passing its output through, and records the run in .anchors/runs/ —
its process, a copy of its output and its exit code —, so "anchors monitor" says how it
ended even when nobody else watched it. The command's exit code is this command's.
```

#### Usage

```bash
anchors monitor run -- <command> [args...] [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` |  | the run's name (default: the program it runs) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

## The work queue — family

Commands of the same family — what tells each apart:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors next`](/docs/cli/commands/next/) | Pull and claim the next item from the queue (the worker calls this) |
| [`anchors queue`](/docs/cli/commands/queue/) | List live tasks (the work the watcher queued) |
| [`anchors work`](/docs/cli/commands/work/) | Emit the work prompt of a stage (spec\|code\|feature\|test\|review) for a target |
| [`anchors done`](/docs/cli/commands/done/) | Close claimed task(s) (moves to the .anchors/done/ history) |
| [`anchors drop`](/docs/cli/commands/drop/) | Discard a task from the queue without completing it (removes; does not archive) |
| [`anchors reclaim`](/docs/cli/commands/reclaim/) | Return to the queue the tasks stuck in claimed (dead worker) |
| [`anchors deliver`](/docs/cli/commands/deliver/) | Record the delivery of a stage — the review trigger |
| [`anchors decided`](/docs/cli/commands/decided/) | Release the card `escalate --for-user` stopped, once the decision is made |
| [`anchors discard`](/docs/cli/commands/discard/) | Take off the board the card that no longer makes sense, without deleting it |
| [`anchors unblock`](/docs/cli/commands/unblock/) | Open the work card that unblocks a card stuck in `needs-user` |
| [`anchors escalate`](/docs/cli/commands/escalate/) | Open the issue for a change needed in the plan or the spec |
| [`anchors report-bug`](/docs/cli/commands/report-bug/) | Report a bug in Anchors itself at github.com/co2-lab/anchors |
| [`anchors synthesize`](/docs/cli/commands/synthesize/) | Two PRs conflicting in CONTENT become a synthesis card |
| [`anchors watch`](/docs/cli/commands/watch/) | The background watcher: sees changes and QUEUES work |
| **`anchors monitor`** | Watch the project's long processes: one line when one starts, stalls, dies or ends |
| [`anchors flow`](/docs/cli/commands/flow/) | Operate the work flows (the puzzle of actions and results) |
| [`anchors board`](/docs/cli/commands/board/) | The project board — published by the pipeline, or served live |
